items.example: The test was a piece of cake.
items.simple: Something so easy that you can do it without trying.

items.example: A joke is a good way to break the ice.
items.exampleTr: Espri buzları eritmek için iyi bir yol.
items.simple: You say or do something so people feel easy and start to talk.

items.example: I'm shattered. I'm going to hit the sack.
items.simple: You go to your bed because you want to sleep.

items.example: I'm still on the fence about moving.
items.simple: You cannot choose between two things yet.

items.example: We only eat out once in a blue moon.
items.simple: Something that happens almost never.

items.example: Just press the button. It's not rocket science.
items.exampleTr: Sadece düğmeye bas. O kadar zor değil.
items.simple: It is easy, so you do not need to be very clever.

items.tr: baklayı ağzından çıkarmak, sırrı ağzından kaçırmak
items.example: Don't spill the beans about the party!
items.simple: You tell a secret that you should keep.

items.en: cost an arm and a leg
items.example: That phone cost an arm and a leg.
items.simple: Something is very, very expensive.

items.example: His rude text was the last straw.
items.exampleTr: Kaba mesajı bardağı taşıran son damlaydı.
items.simple: One more small bad thing, and now you cannot stand it any more.

items.example: You'll get the hang of it soon.
items.simple: At first it is hard, then you slowly learn how to do it.

items.example: I just had to bite the bullet and call him.
items.simple: You do the hard thing even though you do not want to.

items.example: Don't worry, we're all in the same boat.
items.simple: You and other people have the same problem.

items.example: Losing that job was a blessing in disguise.
items.simple: Something looks bad, but later you see it was good.

items.example: Relax, I'm just pulling your leg!
items.simple: You say something not true as a joke to a friend.

items.tr: işi kısa yoldan yapmak, baştan savma
items.example: They cut corners and the roof leaks.
items.exampleTr: İşi baştan savma yaptılar, çatı akıyor.
items.simple: You do a job in a quick way and not as well as you should.

items.example: It's 2 a.m. Let's call it a night.
items.simple: You stop what you are doing in the evening and go home to sleep.

items.en: the ball is in your court
items.example: I've made my offer. The ball is in your court.
items.simple: It is now your turn to do something or choose.

items.example: Just relax? Easier said than done!
items.simple: It sounds simple, but when you try it, it is hard.

items.example: She called me out of the blue.
items.simple: Something happens when you did not think about it at all.

items.example: Let's make sure we're on the same page.
items.simple: You both understand the plan in the same way.

items.tr: önemli değil, abartılacak bir şey değil
items.example: Don't worry, it's no big deal.
items.simple: It is small and not worth worrying about.

items.example: Can you keep an eye on my bag?
items.simple: You look at something carefully so nothing bad happens to it.

items.example: Don't jump the gun. Wait for the results.
items.simple: You start something too early, before it is the right time.

items.example: Take a coat. It's raining cats and dogs!
items.simple: It is raining very, very hard.
